summary: Strengthened statistical-process-analysis skill to prevent custom code generation and handle Excel inputs. Added mandatory Excel-to-CSV conversion step, reinforced gated workflow with explicit failure modes from trace (p-value clamping, schema structure), and added troubleshooting section for common validation failures. The trace showed agent wrote custom analysis code producing invalid schema (nested objects instead of strings, p-value=0.0, missing keys) and skipped validation; these are now explicitly forbidden and trapped.
